## QGIS Protocol

We will produce least-cost paths (LCP) for large predators dispersing from one national park in Montenegro to a more than 20 other protected areas within the region. We provide an introduction to the protocol of operations in QGIS then a video walking you through the full short exercise. These are real scientific data and the LCPs we produce could provide valuable insight for connectivity conservation in the central Balkans.
